page.content:
Michelle Motoretta is a Bragatron 5,000 who appears in Cars. He is painted black, has blue eyes and grey rims. He belongs to The Autobahn Society, along with Sedanya Oskanian and Heather Drifeng.

page.overview:
Who is Michelle Motoretta?

Michelle Motoretta is a Bragatron 5,000 who appears in Cars. He is painted black, has blue eyes and grey rims. He belongs to The Autobahn Society, along with Sedanya Oskanian and Heather Drifeng.
